source_refs.note: Roman Urdu introduction to halogenoalkanes and their classes (PDF 75-76).

blocks.text: Halogenoalkanes rozmarra zindagi mein bohat mufeed hain, zyada tar apne kimiyai istehkaam ki wajah se. Chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) kabhi refrigerants aur aerosol propellants ke taur par use hote the, lekin ab ozone ki teh ko nuqsan pohanchane ki wajah se badle ja rahe hain. Dawa mein halogenated compounds taqatwar anaesthetics hain, aur halogenoalkanes pipes ke liye PVC (polyvinyl chloride) aur non-stick bartanon ke liye PTFE (Teflon) jaise polymers banane mein ahem darmiyani maadde hain.

Halothane, CF3-CHClBr, aik halogenated hydrocarbon hai jo saans ke zariye diye jane wale taqatwar anaesthetic ke taur par aam use hota hai: yeh operation ke dauran hosh ko aarzi taur par khatam karta hai. Pehle use hone wale chloroform aur doosre chlorinated anaesthetics ab zehreele hone ki wajah se use nahi hote.

blocks.alt: Halothane ki khuli (displayed) banawat: aik carbon jis par teen F atoms (baen, oopar, neeche), doosre carbon se jura jis par oopar Cl, neeche H aur daen Br hai.
blocks.caption: Halothane ki banawat (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Halogenoalkane
blocks.text: Halogenoalkane tab banta hai jab alkane ke aik ya zyada hydrogen atoms halogen atoms (X = F, Cl, Br ya I) se badal jayein. Aik, do, teen ya zyada halogen atoms hon to yeh mono-, di-, tri- ya polyhalogenoalkane hai. Monohalogenoalkanes ko alkyl halides, R-X, bhi kehte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen khuli banawatein, har aik mein carbon ke baen H aur daen X: monohalogenoalkane (oopar neeche H), dihalogenoalkane (oopar X, neeche H) aur trihalogenoalkane (oopar neeche X).
blocks.caption: Mono-, di- aur trihalogenoalkanes (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Primary: X wala carbon aik ya kisi bhi doosre carbon se nahi jura, maslan chloromethane CH3Cl, chloroethane CH3CH2Cl, 1-chloropropane CH3CH2CH2Cl.

blocks.alt: Teen primary halogenoalkanes dabbon mein: CH3-Cl chloromethane, CH3-CH2-Cl chloroethane aur CH3-CH2-CH2-Cl 1-chloropropane.
blocks.caption: Primary halogenoalkanes ki misalein (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Secondary: X wala carbon do doosre carbon atoms se jura, maslan 2-chloropropane (CH3)2CHCl aur 2-chlorobutane CH3CHClCH2CH3.

blocks.alt: 2-chloropropane: do CH3 groups CH-Cl se jure; aur 2-chlorobutane, CH3-CH(Cl)-CH2-CH3, jis mein Cl doosre carbon ke oopar hai.
blocks.caption: Secondary halogenoalkanes ki misalein (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Tertiary: X wala carbon teen doosre carbon atoms se jura, maslan 2-chloro-2-methylpropane (CH3)3CCl.

blocks.alt: 2-chloro-2-methylpropane: darmiyani carbon jis ke daen Cl, baen H3C aur oopar neeche CH3 hain.
blocks.caption: Tertiary halogenoalkane ki misal (kitab ke PDF safha 76 ki be-number figure ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.prompt: C4H9Cl formula ke sab structures batayein aur har aik ko primary, secondary ya tertiary batayein.

items: Halogenoalkane: alkane jis ke H ki jagah F, Cl, Br ya I; R-X.
Primary, secondary, tertiary: X wale C ke 1 (ya 0), 2 ya 3 C parosi.
